title: Jesus Thank You
lyrics_original: Your blood has washed away my sin,
Once Your enemy, now seated at Your table,
Your enemy You made Your friend

Lover of my soul, I want to live for You.

Once Your enemy, now seated at Your table,

bible_verses.english: But he was wounded for our transgressions. He was bruised for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his stripes we are healed.
According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I stand humbled before the mystery and grace of the cross. Thank You for bearing the punishment I deserved and washing away my sins with Your precious blood. Because of Your sacrifice, I am completely forgiven, welcomed, and loved by the Father. Help me to live each day in the light of Your boundless mercy, with a heart overflowing with unending gratitude. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: The profound mystery of the cross leaves us in quiet wonder, knowing that Jesus willingly bore the weight of our sin so we could know eternal freedom. On Calvary, He drank the bitter cup meant for us, satisfying God's justice with pure and undeserved love. When we remember the immense price paid for our salvation, our hearts cannot help but overflow with gratitude. Today, take a quiet moment to rest in His finished work and simply offer Him your heart's joyful praise: "Jesus, thank You."
